title: Nine Minutes of Morning
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：breakfast　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 breakfast 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to cook ① a breakfast she could not eat, and she said the eating was the whole of the lesson. The ② breakfast, meaning the meal and not the morning, was nine minutes long and was cleared by whoever came last; a breakfast, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ breakfast in that house had the same tea, and the ④ breakfast at the end, meaning the one the father made and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever ate properly. A breakfast, my grandmother said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the habit is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ breakfast was the whole of the morning, meaning the hours it opened and not the meal. The ⑥ breakfast, meaning the morning and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody shares and nobody questions; a breakfast, he said, is either something you cook or the only word that means both a meal and a morning. She said the morning is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ breakfast had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the tea. The ⑧ breakfast of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine minutes of habit and eleven years of cooking; a breakfast, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ breakfast I remember is the one at the end, which was shared in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ breakfast, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every breakfast, she said, is a morning that has agreed to look like a meal. She said the morning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 早餐（指那顿饭本身，与那个早晨相对）
C. 固定搭配：cook a breakfast 做一顿早餐
D. n. 早餐（指那座房子里每一顿）
E. n. 早餐（指末尾那一顿）
F. n. 早餐（抽象：它开启的那个上午）
G. n. 那个上午（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a breakfast she could not eat
The breakfast, meaning the meal and not the morning
breakfast was the whole of the morning
the breakfast had become a photograph in a report
The breakfast of the whole thing
A breakfast, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: cook a breakfast 意为“做一顿早餐”，1952 年母亲被派去做一顿她吃不下的早餐。
breakfast 意为“早餐”，指那顿饭本身而不是那个早晨，只花九分钟，由最后走的人收拾。
breakfast 指那座房子里每一顿早餐，每一顿都是同样的茶。
breakfast 指末尾那一顿（父亲做的那一顿），是唯一有人认真吃过的。
breakfast 意为“早餐”，抽象指它开启的那个上午，父亲说 breakfast 就是那个上午的全部。
breakfast 为抽象用法，指那个上午本身，是一家人人人都分享、却没人质疑的东西。
breakfast 意为“早餐、早饭”，到 1969 年这顿 breakfast 成了报告里的一张照片。
breakfast 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九分钟的习惯和十一年的做饭。
breakfast 意为“早餐”，我记得的是末尾那一顿，1974 年被分着吃，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
breakfast 为抽象总称，祖母说早餐是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。
